description: A scatter plot matrix (Plotly splom): 2 to 6 numeric dimensions on one grid, every dimension on a shared axis across its row and column, so each cell plots one dimension against another and a pattern between any two shows at a glance. Below the diagonal each cell is a small scatter plot of every complete row (the upper half too with show_upper); the diagonal names the dimension; wide pages also show each dimension's range on the outer edges. Each axis comes from d3 nice() and ticks() on the server, so there is no script. A legend lists every dimension with its range and a hidden table gives every value of every row. Static: no hover or brushing. Motion-ready: each cell fades in through --k from --p (default 1).
